title: Finite scalar restriction and pro-etale adjunction units
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a unital homomorphism of finite rings, neither assumed commutative. Use compatible small pro-etale sites, coefficient sheaves $R_T,S_T$ and categories of left module sheaves as in [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. The maps $\varphi_T:R_T\to S_T$ are induced by pointwise composition with $\varphi$ on continuous functions and sheafification. Let $P_T:\operatorname{Mod}(S_T)\to\operatorname{Mod}(R_T)$ be restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. For $C=R,S$, let $f_C^*$ be the inverse image with transported action [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-exact] through the canonical ring isomorphism $c^C_f:f^{-1}C_Y\xrightarrow{\sim}C_X$ [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map], and let $f_{C,*}$ be direct image with scalar action through the adjunct $C_Y\to f_*C_X$ [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Use the module adjunctions induced by the inverse-image/direct-image adjunction on abelian sheaves, and denote their units by $\eta^C$.

There are natural isomorphisms
$$\alpha_N:P_X(f_S^*N)\xrightarrow{\sim}f_R^*(P_YN),\qquad
\beta_M:P_Y(f_{S,*}M)\xrightarrow{\sim}f_{R,*}(P_XM),$$
for every $S_Y$-module sheaf $N$ and $S_X$-module sheaf $M$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Their underlying abelian-sheaf maps are the identity under the displayed constructions. They preserve the specified adjunction unit: for every $N$,
$$f_{R,*}(\alpha_N)\circ\beta_{f_S^*N}\circ P_Y(\eta^S_N)=\eta^R_{P_YN}.$$
No flatness, immersion, Noetherian, support or constructibility assumption is imposed.

source.place: Tag 03D3, lemma-adjoint-push-pull-modules: lifting the abelian adjunction and its unit; agent coefficient-naturality refinement for the transported-action finite-ring inverse images (noncommutative rings included).

proof.text: Pointwise composition with φ commutes with pullback of continuous functions. Apply the sheafification adjunction and naturality of its unit to prove φ_Y ≫ rho_S = rho_R ≫ f_*(φ_X). Define beta by sectionwise identity linear equivalences; the square proves linearity.

Use finiteModuleAdjunction_existsUnique, evaluating its transpose normalization at the identity morphism, to obtain adjR and adjS normalized by finiteScalarModuleUnitSection. Apply the unit-normalized abelian comparison for each ring to obtain eR and eS.

Take the mate δ of beta under adjS and adjR. The mate unit equation determines its composite with the restricted S-unit. Use the eR and eS unit equations and injectivity of the abelian adjunction homEquiv to identify the underlying δ with eR followed by eS inverse. Thus δ is invertible, since forgetting module structure reflects isomorphisms. Set alpha to its inverse. The underlying alpha identity follows by cancellation; compose the mate unit equation with f_R,*(alpha) to obtain the required actual-unit equation.

The parent lem-exc-proetale-supported-kernel-complex uses the item for Z/n -> A exactly as stated. The mathematics is correct. Step 1 holds because the identity is R_X-linear exactly when c^S∘f^{-1}φ_Y = φ_X∘c^R. Step 2 needs the equivalent equality ρ^S φ_Y = f_*(φ_X) ρ^R. Step 3's unit equation holds because every underlying map is the identity or η_f and the forgetful functor is faithful. Small cases checked: X empty, R = 0, φ = id, and noncommutative M_2(F_p). Fixes (no new nodes, statement unchanged): (1) Step 1 only gestured at the coefficient-map equality. I wrote out the argument: pass to adjuncts, check on constant sections, glue over an open cover, then use sheafification. I also wrote out that f^{-1}(P_Y N) carries the f^{-1}-transformed restricted action, since f^{-1} preserves finite products. (2) Step 2 cited def-weil-proetale-inverse-image for ρ, but that node defines ρ only for commutative constant A. I added the missing citation of prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map, which defines ρ for noncommutative pro-étale coefficients. Tool uses for the maintainer to record: prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map and prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-exact (unit sk-thm-properbasechange). That unit is outside the sk-prop-sf-localization route, but these are generic coefficient facts that nothing in the route supplies, and other sec-smooth-purity nodes already use them as tools. No duplicate found, no SGA source used.; 1 file(s) fixed by the reviewer
